description: AsyncAPI operation, message, reply-message, and protocol-cell accounting.

scenarios.description: A publish target remains represented while every governing message, reply message, and effective server/protocol cell receives a disposition.
An unincorporated AsyncAPI edition is refused rather than accepted by major-line inference.
A reply-bearing send synthesizes both application directions independently of installed driver capability.
A reply declared as a Reference Object into components.replies synthesizes identically to the inline reply form, including the declared reply-message identity.

An artifact whose payload schemas use Draft-07 spellings the OBI dialect changed (tuple items, additionalItems, dependencies, a declared $schema) synthesizes fully represented: Schema Objects enter OBI positions under semantic-preserving dialect translation, never verbatim copy and never whole-artifact refusal.

A message whose effective content type has no JSON application-value carriage (application/octet-stream) cannot be invoked today: input encoding has no codec seam, so the runtime refuses before dispatch. The synthesis contract forbids presenting a statically-refusing operation as usable, so the target is implementation-unsupported (visible MC2 debt, discharged by a codec extension path) rather than lossy, and no operation is emitted. Distinct from schema-LANGUAGE loss (SS-07), which stays invocable and lossy.

An AsyncAPI 3 Multi Format Schema Object declaring a non-JSON-Schema language (payload: {schemaFormat: avro, schema}) cannot contribute a faithful schema: the direction floors to the unconstrained representation and accounts as lossy under asyncapi.schema_format_not_convertible. Distinct from the carriage case: this loss has a conversion-shaped revisit trigger. The wrapper itself must never be emitted as the OBI schema.

An AsyncAPI 3 Multi Format Schema Object declaring the official JSON Schema Draft-07 media type unwraps to its schema member, which enters the OBI under dialect translation: the wrapper is never emitted as the schema (its schemaFormat/schema members are not 2020-12 vocabulary and would bury the real contract while validating as unconstrained), and the artifact is fully represented.

An operation declared in components.operations and referenced from the operations map synthesizes identically to the inline form: the operations-map entry resolves through the reference before the operation-object test, and the binding ref remains the operations-map pointer.

A channels-map entry declared as a Reference Object into components.channels synthesizes identically to the inline channel: message inventory, server effectivity, and coverage identity survive the spelling.
A channel message declared as a Reference Object into components.messages synthesizes identically to the inline message, and coverage retains the artifact's deepest declared message address.

A channel's servers subset (Reference Objects into the servers map) restricts the effective servers: only the referenced member appears as a server alternative, and a single effective server needs no configuration choice.
A message payload declared as a reference into components.schemas resolves before schema copy: the OBI carries the resolved, translated schema, never a dangling pointer.
A message trait supplying contentType merges before carriage evaluation: the trait-declared JSON content type keeps the direction fully represented rather than floored.

A payload referencing a self-recursive components schema synthesizes with the cycle hoisted into the operation schema's $defs and every surviving reference rewritten to point there: the recursion the artifact declared survives the projection, the emitted interface is valid (OBI-D-16), and the artifact is fully represented — never a whole-artifact refusal.

A payload declaration invalid under its own declared dialect (minimum: true is ill-formed in every accepted edition's Schema Object) is the artifact's defect, confined to exactly the affected operation (ASYNC-P-05): that target is invalid with asyncapi.payload_schema_invalid, its alternatives cascade, and the sibling operation synthesizes untouched — never a whole-artifact refusal.

prefixItems is not vocabulary in any accepted edition's default Schema Object, so the author's dialect ignored it; an empty array carried verbatim into 2020-12 would turn that inert annotation into an ill-formed keyword. Translation drops the empty spelling (preserving the declared no-op semantics exactly) and the artifact stays fully represented.
